title: persona-core pins serde_json = "1" locally instead of inheriting from workspace.dependencies
description:
persona-core/Cargo.toml declares 'serde_json = "1"' as a plain version requirement. Every other member (persona-attestors, persona-grpc, personad, persona, persona-nmh) uses 'serde_json.workspace = true', and the root Cargo.toml [workspace.dependencies] already defines serde_json = "1".

It resolves to the same crate today, so nothing breaks now. The cost is that a future change to the workspace pin — a bump, a feature addition such as 'preserve_order' or 'arbitrary_precision', or default-features = false — silently skips persona-core. serde_json features are additive and unify across the graph, so a feature added at the workspace level would reach persona-core anyway while a *version floor* raise would not, which is exactly the confusing half-applied case.

Change to 'serde_json.workspace = true'. This is the only member that opts out of workspace inheritance for any dependency.
close_reason: Duplicate of persona-5s4b.104 (same defect, filed by a second review agent from a different angle). Merged during review triage; reopen if the angle in this issue is not covered there.
